questions.question: English Grammar & Usage #16: Convert to Passive Voice: 'The mechanic repaired the damaged engine.'
options: The damaged engine was repaired by the mechanic.
The mechanic was repairing the engine.
The engine is repaired by mechanic.
The engine has been repaired by mechanic.

questions.question: English Grammar & Usage #17: Choose the correct indirect speech: 'He said, "I am learning English."'
options: He said that he had learned English.
He said that he was learning English.
He told he is learning English.
He said that I was learning English.
questions.hint: Present continuous 'am learning' shifts to past continuous 'was learning'.

questions.question: English Grammar & Usage #18: Convert to Active Voice: 'A song was being sung by Lata.'
questions.hint: 'was being sung' converts to active 'was singing'.
